form.label: CoolaShaker - Server Infrastructure
form.description: VMware and Windows Server performance monitoring

search.query: | mstats avg(_value) as avg_cpu WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ | eval avg_cpu=round(avg_cpu, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cpu <= 70, "low", avg_cpu <= 85, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cpu low=0-70 elevated=70-85 severe=85-100

| mstats avg(_value) as avg_cpu WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ | eval avg_cpu=round(avg_cpu, 1) | eval range=case( avg_cpu <= 70, "low", avg_cpu <= 85, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_cpu low=0-70 elevated=70-85 severe=85-100
| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ BY vm_name | stats dc(vm_name) as vm_count
| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ BY host | stats dc(host) as esxi_count
| mstats avg(_value) as cpu_usage WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ BY vm_name span=5m | timechart span=5m avg(cpu_usage) by vm_name
| mstats avg(_value) as memory_gb WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name=vmware.vm.memory.usage.gb location=$location_token$ BY vm_name span=5m | timechart span=5m avg(memory_gb) by vm_name

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_type=esxi_host location=$location_token$ AND (metric_name=vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.memory.usage.pct) BY metric_name host span=5m | eval metric_label=case( metric_name="vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct", "CPU %", metric_name="vmware.esxi.memory.usage.pct", "Memory %") | eval metric_label=host + ":" + metric_label | timechart span=5m avg(value) by metric_label

| mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_type=esxi_host location=$location_token$ AND (metric_name=vmware.esxi.network.rx.mbps OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.network.tx.mbps) BY metric_name host span=5m | eval metric_label=case( metric_name="vmware.esxi.network.rx.mbps", "RX (Mbps)", metric_name="vmware.esxi.network.tx.mbps", "TX (Mbps)") | eval metric_label=host + ":" + metric_label | timechart span=5m avg(value) by metric_label
| mstats avg(_value) as cpu_usage WHERE index=demo_windows_metrics metric_name=windows.cpu.usage.pct location=$location_token$ BY server span=5m | timechart span=5m avg(cpu_usage) by server
| mstats avg(_value) as memory_usage WHERE index=demo_windows_metrics metric_name=windows.memory.usage.pct location=$location_token$ BY server span=5m | timechart span=5m avg(memory_usage) by server

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics AND (metric_name=vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct OR metric_name=vmware.vm.memory.usage.gb OR metric_name=vmware.vm.disk.usage.pct) AND location=$location_token$ BY vm_name location metric_name | eval metric_type=case( metric_name="vmware.vm.cpu.usage.pct", "CPU", metric_name="vmware.vm.memory.usage.gb", "Memory", metric_name="vmware.vm.disk.usage.pct", "Disk") | eval value=round(value, 1) | chart first(value) over vm_name by metric_type | rename vm_name as "VM Name", CPU as "CPU %", Memory as "Memory (GB)", Disk as "Disk %" | sort "VM Name"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_type=esxi_host location=$location_token$ AND (metric_name=vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.memory.usage.pct OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.network.rx.mbps OR metric_name=vmware.esxi.network.tx.mbps) BY host location metric_name | eval metric_type=case( metric_name="vmware.esxi.cpu.usage.pct", "CPU", metric_name="vmware.esxi.memory.usage.pct", "Memory", metric_name="vmware.esxi.network.rx.mbps", "Net RX", metric_name="vmware.esxi.network.tx.mbps", "Net TX") | eval value=round(value, 1) | chart first(value) over host by metric_type | rename host as "ESXi Host", CPU as "CPU %", Memory as "Memory %", "Net RX" as "RX (Mbps)", "Net TX" as "TX (Mbps)" | sort "ESXi Host"

| mstats latest(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_windows_metrics location=$location_token$ AND (metric_name=windows.cpu.usage.pct OR metric_name=windows.memory.usage.pct OR metric_name=windows.disk.usage.pct OR metric_name=windows.disk.queue.length) BY server location metric_name | eval metric_type=case( metric_name="windows.cpu.usage.pct", "CPU", metric_name="windows.memory.usage.pct", "Memory", metric_name="windows.disk.usage.pct", "Disk", metric_name="windows.disk.queue.length", "Disk Queue") | eval value=round(value, 1) | chart first(value) over server by metric_type | rename server as "Windows Server", CPU as "CPU %", Memory as "Memory %", Disk as "Disk %", "Disk Queue" as "Disk Queue Len" | sort "Windows Server"

index=demo_windows_events location=$location_token$ EventType=Error OR EventType=Warning | eval event_time=strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | stats values(*) as * by event_time,EventCode | sort - event_time | head 20 | table event_time ComputerName location EventCode EventType SourceName Message | rename event_time as "Time", location as "Location", ComputerName as "Host", EventCode as "Event Code", EventType as "Type", SourceName as "Source", Message as "Message"
